changelog: - **Operator AI tasks need the AI pack; the registry's `audience` decides** (#1738, epic #1727). Every entry in `src/lib/ai/tasks.ts` carries `audience: 'participant' | 'operator'`. For an `operator` task (`mentor_match`, `survey_summary`, `evaluation_insights`, `weekly_report_digest`, `analytics_narrative`) `runAiGated` asks `entitled(orgId, 'AI_PACKAGE')` (`AI_PACK_FEATURE`) right after consent and before the artefact cache and returns the new typed denial `{ ok: false, reason: 'not_entitled' }`; a `participant` task (`cv_extract`, `cv_feedback`, `interview_prep`, `interaction_summary`) never runs the query, so the free core stays free and its routes and screens are unchanged. The operator routes answer the shared `403 { code: 'feature_locked', feature: 'AI_PACKAGE' }` and their `GET`s report `locked`, so `/admin/insights`, the analytics narrative and the survey results page draw a locked state; `POST /api/admin/mentor-suggest` keeps the rule-based ranking for every admin and answers `200 { …, aiUsed: false, locked: 'AI_PACKAGE' }`. **Existing orgs keep the tools:** `prisma/backfill-ai-package-grandfather.mjs` (run by `infra/deploy-prod.sh`) grants `AI_PACKAGE` to every org that exists on the deploy — once; its grants carry a marker note and a later run that finds one does nothing, so orgs created after the gate are really gated (unit-tested in `scripts/test/ai-package-grandfather.test.mjs`). `prisma/seed-demo.mjs` grants the pack to both demo tenants so every topic environment shows the whole product.

en: The admin AI tools — the match rationale, survey summaries, open-text insights and the analytics narrative — are now part of the AI pack. Everything a mentee or mentor uses for themselves stays free, and organisations that already had the tools keep them.
tr: Yönetici yapay zekâ araçları — eşleştirme gerekçesi, anket özetleri, açık metin içgörüleri ve analitik anlatısı — artık AI paketinin parçası. Mentee ve mentorların kendileri için kullandığı her şey ücretsiz kalıyor; bu araçlara zaten sahip olan kurumlar onları korumaya devam ediyor.
de: Die KI-Werkzeuge für Administratoren — Matching-Begründung, Umfrage-Zusammenfassungen, Freitext-Insights und die Analytics-Erzählung — gehören jetzt zum KI-Paket. Alles, was Mentees und Mentoren für sich selbst nutzen, bleibt kostenlos, und Organisationen, die die Werkzeuge bereits hatten, behalten sie.
